text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the removal of an on-street accessible loading zone located on the west side of Euclid Avenue, between a point 68 metres south of Ulster Street and a point 11 metres further south.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone, in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 a.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Euclid Avenue, between a point 68 metres south of Ulster Street and a point 11 metres further south.
